items.name: Arizona Corporation Commission Entity Search
items.notes: Would substantially improve shell-company resolution. Held back deliberately pending a privacy review.

items.name: SEC EDGAR Full-Text Search
items.historical_coverage: Filings from 2001 onward in full-text search.
items.notes: Useful for confirming operator identity from primary filings rather than inference.

items.name: EPA ECHO Air Facility Records
items.geographic_coverage: Nationwide; queried per city within the study area
items.historical_coverage: Active and historical Clean Air Act permitted facilities.
items.known_schema_issues: Two-step API: get_facilities returns a QueryID consumed by get_qid. Facility coordinates are sometimes geocoded rather than surveyed, so spatial matches use a distance tolerance. Public endpoints may return HTTP 429 under load.
items.notes: Connector keeps facilities whose NAICS/name indicate data-processing or hosting and emits backup_generator_air_permit evidence. Ordinary industrial air permits are filtered. Fixtures cover CI when the live API throttles.

items.name: Maricopa County Air Quality Dust Control Sites
items.known_schema_issues: The Dust Control Site layer exposes only ImpactID and geometry; the permit attributes that would make it useful as a construction signal are not published through this service.
items.notes: Deferred to a later sprint. Earth-disturbance registrations would be a strong Stage 4 signal if the attribute set can be joined from another AQD service.

items.name: EIA Existing Electricity Generation Capacity by State
items.geographic_coverage: All US states and DC. State resolution only.
items.historical_coverage: 1990 to the most recent published year.
items.known_schema_issues: Published only as xlsx. Producer type and fuel source each carry a roll-up row alongside their parts, so reading the sheet naively double counts. Helios keeps only the all-producers, all-fuels row.
items.notes: The supply side of the same question the sales figures answer from the demand side. This is installed capacity, not generation, and it says nothing about whether any particular site could be served -- that would need interconnection data Helios does not have.

items.name: EIA Retail Electricity Sales by State
items.geographic_coverage: All US states and DC. State resolution only.
items.historical_coverage: 1990 to the most recent published year.
items.known_schema_issues: Published only as xlsx; EIA offers no CSV equivalent. Provider categories overlap, so only the 'Total Electric Industry' roll-up is read. No public source breaks retail sales to county nationally, so unlike the water totals this cannot be narrowed to a metro area.
items.notes: The electricity counterpart to the USGS water totals. Its state granularity is coarser than the county water figures, and every row records which it is so the two are never read as comparable.

items.name: OpenStreetMap Power Infrastructure (Overpass API)
items.jurisdiction: Global (queried for the East Valley study area)
items.attribution_text: Power infrastructure data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL.
items.historical_coverage: Current snapshot only via Overpass. Attic queries could provide history but are expensive and not used.
items.known_schema_issues: Voltage is a semicolon-delimited string in volts. Completeness is contributor-dependent: absence of a substation is not evidence it does not exist.

items.name: Maricopa County Assessor Parcel Layer
items.agency: Maricopa County Assessor / Maricopa County GIS
items.attribution_text: Parcel data courtesy of Maricopa County Assessor / Maricopa County GIS.
items.historical_coverage: Current assessment roll only. Exposes the most recent recorded deed per parcel, not the full transfer chain, which truncates observable ownership history.
items.known_schema_issues: Date fields are epoch milliseconds. OwnerName is a single unstructured string mixing companies, trusts, and private individuals. Wide LIKE scans are slow (~24s observed), so queries should be bounded by geometry or city first.

items.name: Maricopa County Recorder Document Search
items.notes: Helios links out to recorder documents for human verification rather than ingesting them.

items.name: City of Mesa Building Permits
items.geographic_coverage: Mesa, Arizona (street-filtered for East Valley corridors)
items.known_schema_issues: The public view exposes only permit number, type, address, status, and three dates. There is no valuation, work description, or applicant, and no coordinates, so permits are matched to parcels by normalized address string alone.
items.notes: Ingests commercial (COM) permits on East Valley corridors and matches them onto assessor parcels via helios_geospatial.addresses. Residential permits are excluded as noise.

items.name: City of Mesa Planning and Zoning Agendas
items.access_limitation: Planning cases are published as council and commission agenda attachments rather than a queryable dataset. Uses FixtureBackedConnector to parse downloaded PDF agendas.

items.name: Arizona Corporation Commission eDocket
items.notes: Transmission and substation filings here are the single highest-weight signal in the scoring model, so this gap materially limits Stage 3 recall. It is recorded prominently in the limitations documentation.
items.access_limitation: eDocket search is a stateful ASP.NET interface requiring viewstate round-trips and offering no documented API or bulk export. Helios implements and tests the parser against fixtures built from the documented docket schema, and does not automate the search interface. Live coverage requires either an agency-provided export or manual docket retrieval.

items.geographic_coverage: SRP service territory including much of the East Valley

items.name: Arizona Department of Water Resources Data
items.geographic_coverage: Arizona, including the Phoenix Active Management Area
items.historical_coverage: Long historical series for groundwater and withdrawals.
items.notes: Needed before any water-use scenario is published. Deferred.

items.name: USGS Estimated Use of Water, County-Level
items.attribution_text: Dieter, C.A., and others, 2018, Estimated use of water in the United States county-level data for 2015 (ver. 2.0): U.S. Geological Survey data release, https://doi.org/10.5066/F7TB15V5.
items.geographic_coverage: All 3,223 US counties and county equivalents.
items.historical_coverage: Five-yearly compilations back to 1950. 2015 is the most recent release carrying a county breakdown.
items.known_schema_issues: A citation line sits above the real header row. Withdrawals are in million gallons per day; population is in thousands and is rescaled to people on ingest. The 2020 compilation dropped the county breakdown, so 2015 is the newest county figure that exists rather than the newest Helios fetched.
items.notes: Supplies the reported denominator that Helios's inferred per-site water estimates are shown against. It is a whole-county withdrawal total covering every user, so it is context, never a baseline to subtract from.
